title: Band Officer (II/III) (LtCol to Capt) and (CWO3 to WO) PMOS, DIR COMM
raw_text:
1. MOS 5502, Band Officer (II/III) (LtCol to Capt) and (CWO3 to WO) PMOS,
DIR COMM

    a. Summary. MOS 5502 is assigned to Band Officers serving as either the
principal or assistant director of a Marine Corps Band. They may serve as
the sole Band Officer at a location, dependent on assignment, or as part of a
director/assistant director leadership team. Band Officers function as
special staff officers of the commanding general by providing information and
recommendations on the use, current capabilities, standing procedures, and
policies governing the operation of a Marine Corps Band. Band Officers serve
as the officer in charge of Marine Corps Bands where they manage, administer,
and coordinate musical performances, develop budgets and annual operation
plans, direct internal operations and training, and supervise the employment
of a Marine Corps Band. Band Officers must also maintain a working knowledge
of applicable copyright regulations and directives. Band Officers regularly
coordinate and liaise with their local and adjacent commands, higher
headquarters, HQMC Communication Directorate, Marine Corps Recruiting
Command, and other applicable agencies to provide musical support for
community relations and personnel procurement programs.

       b.    Prerequisites

        (1) Must be a graduate of the Advanced Musician Course (N0355K2) at
the Naval School of Music.

        (2) Must be a graduate of the Music Unit Leader Course (N0355L2) at
the Naval School of Music.

        (3) Must meet eligibility and appointment criteria as prescribed in
MCO 1040.42B, WO and LDO accession programs.

        (4) Must have a recommendation letter from a band officer stating
that the individual meets the minimum technical requirements.

       c.    Requirements

        (1) Complete the Warrant Officer Basic Course (WOBC) (M02RMN4) within
18 months of appointment to WO.

        (2) In addition to eligibility criteria outlined in MCO 1040.42B,
applicants must have a minimum time in service of 8 years and no more than 20
years of active naval service as of the convening date of the enlisted to WO
selection board.

        (3) This MOS may only be assigned to warrant officers who were
previously qualified in enlisted MOSs 5519 to 5567. Follow-on training is
the Advanced Music Course (N0355K2); and the Audition Training Course
(N0355N2), upon completion of the Warrant Officer Basic Course (WOBC), if not
already completed.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (be), Music Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Music Directors and Composers 27-2041.



                                           1-222                 Enclosure (1)
 1131                                                                NAVMC 1200.1L



       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
